text:
alex: Promo blocked — postsubmit job `bundle-upload` is timing out with 504s to s3, deploybot auto-paused the promotion.

deploy-bot: Promotion paused: artifact upload failed (504) · attempts=5/5 · action=hold

maya: Ugh, seen this intermittently. Which artifact? frontend bundle? logs?

alex: frontend v2026.3.2 -> trying to push `bundle-frontend-2026.3.2.tgz`. Uploads stall during `PUT` with `504 Gateway Timeout`.

ryan: grabbing logs from buildkite: 
```
ERROR: PutObject upload failed: 504 Gateway Timeout after 30s
Trace: s3.amazonaws.com -> 10.0.12.34: timeout
```

ryan: Also seeing high retry rate from the CI runners -> backoff thrash.

sre-oncall: @ryan can you check if the eu-west object endpoint is degraded? I'll open ticket with infra.

ryan: traceroute shows packet loss to the storage frontends. filing #infra-ticket-6421 and pinging storage team :phone:

alex: We need a decision for the promo window. Options: wait for infra fix, manual promote older image, or rollback. Thoughts?

maya: If we wait, CI will keep blowing credit and block release window. Recommend pin to last-good `sha:aa11bb22` and manual promote to unblock.

ryan: I agree. Last good image passed all smoke e2e. Manual promote + postmortem later.

deploy-bot: Manual promote requested by @maya. To proceed run: `/deploybot promote --sha aa11bb22 --env prod --reason "upload outage"`

alex: OK doing manual promote now. I'll also add release note entry: "promo paused due to artifact upload 504; manual promote to previous image aa11bb22; hotfix to follow if regressions".

sre-oncall: infra ticket linked: #infra-ticket-6421 — storage team acknowledged increased 504 rate and is rolling a config change. ETA 20–40m.

alex: After promote completes let's hold on releasing new bundle until infra green. Will schedule a new promo for next change window if upload succeeds.

maya: Thanks all. If promote succeeds, I'll patch the release notes and notify PMs. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Promotion succeeded: image sha aa11bb22 promoted to prod at 2026-03-23T14:12:34Z. No post-deploy alerts observed.

alex: Confirmed traffic looks normal. Closing promo hold. Follow-ups: (1) infra postmortem (2) re-run upload & new promo in next change window. 

maya: I'll own (2). Assigning to maya in release tracker.

sre-oncall: noting incident in incidents channel and scheduling follow-up with storage team.
